question:
**Direction: Select the correct pair of synonyms to fill in the blanks.**

Seema was shivering, and her body was almost ______ due to the long exposure to ______ winds from the mountains.
solution:
The correct answer is **"frozen, icy."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Frozen"** and **"icy"** are synonyms.
 
• **"Frozen"** means (used about food) stored at a low temperature in order to keep it for a long time. ((खाद्य पदार्थ) सुरक्षित रखने के लिए कम तापमान पर भंडारण)
 
 
• **Example**: *She bought **frozen**__ vegetables.*
 
 
 
• **"Icy" **means very cold. (बहुत ठंडा, बर्फ़ीला)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He fell into the **icy**__ waters of the Moscow river.*
 
 
 
• The sentence describes Seema's body as almost frozen, indicating that she was very cold.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 **(warm, steamy)**

 
 
• **Warm: **having a pleasant temperature that is fairly high, between cool and hot. ((ठंडे और गरम के बीच का सुहावना तापमान) शरीर को भाने वाली गरमाहट से युक्त)
 
• **Steam: **the hot gas that is produced by boiling water. (वाष्‍प, भाप (खौलते पानी से उत्‍पन्‍न गरम गैस))
 
 
 
• Option 3 **(dry, arid)**
 
 
• **Dry: **without liquid in it or on it; not wet. (सूखा, शुष्‍क)
 
• **Arid:**
 
 
 
• Option 4 **(wet, humid)**
 
 
• **Wet: **covered in a liquid, especially water. ((पानी या अन्‍य द्रव से) गीला, तर, भीगा हुआ, आर्द्र, नम)
 
• **Humid: **(used about the air or climate) containing a lot of water; damp. ((वायु या मौसम) सीलनभरा, आर्द्र, नम)
